## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (compile + lint + fmt)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing changes
- [ ] Small, per-directory commits (didn't bundle the whole feature into one commit)
- [ ] Did not bump the version or add tags
